dependency_profiles.additional_repository: aos_zfs_runtime supplies version.env from the AOS OpenZFS package version through an immutable Nix override; no executable or network access.

limits: Checks selected target and macro profiles, not complete compiler/default, native ABI, linker, editor, production, or performance equivalence.

Native static installation, exact native features and compiled version, release tests and admission errors only. Real pools, module loading, sysfs writes, foreign hosts, numeric performance budgets and default cutover remain separate gates.
Cargo remains the default. Real pools, module loading, sysfs writes, foreign hosts, numeric performance acceptance and default cutover remain separate gates.

The actual installed Cargo package is the production feature oracle. An independent Cargo release build runs the library and all nine empty command-test targets; Bazel runs the library, four installed command-test targets and the empty doctest target.
The packaged ZFS version is reconstructed from three actual fresh Bazel compiler executions and one actual Cargo memory-policy test compiler; version.env is an exact hashed Bazel compiler input.
Fresh Linux sandbox execution does not establish concurrent shared-cache performance.
No Rust source changes. The completed application test-target compilation for current Rust bytes is recorded in test-support-spec-index-full-rust-compilation.json.
